scope: Actual presentation methods with declared target/condition/transform fixtures. No gameplay repair, progression, navigation or human-perception acceptance.

checks.name: focused field anchors to actual world position beneath transformed parent
tether starts at Core world position and ends at target world position
one sustained contact may finish visual acquisition
an unstable contacted body retains disagreement after long hold
improved actual material condition permits alignment without restarting contact
target switch cannot inherit the previous acquisition
release hides field and forgets material condition; rehold begins new acquisition
another focus condition cannot leak into the current target
missing condition stays explicit and uses visual-acquisition fallback
material condition and gameplay snapshot are never mutated
interaction assist uses the target world position
unparented targets retain their existing coordinates
committed Silt visual target retains its explicit published position
presentation retains the same three gyro bands
an ambient fallback cannot borrow a stale material condition by id
